title: The Patents Act, 1970
summary: Primary Indian patent statute. Section 3 includes exclusions relevant to traditional knowledge, known properties and admixtures; patentability assessment also requires novelty, inventive step and industrial applicability.

title: Traditional Knowledge Digital Library
authority: CSIR and Ministry of AYUSH, Government of India
summary: Official Indian initiative documenting traditional medicinal knowledge for defensive protection and prior-art examination. Public access is limited; a definitive clearance search requires authorized databases and expert review.

title: Biological Diversity Act, 2002 and Rules
authority: National Biodiversity Authority, Government of India
summary: Indian biodiversity and access-and-benefit-sharing framework. Applicability depends on the resource, persons involved, access, research, commercial utilization and IP activity; the 2023 amendment and current rules must be checked for the transaction date.

title: Food Safety and Standards (Ayurveda Aahara) Regulations, 2022
authority: Food Safety and Standards Authority of India
summary: Regulates qualifying Ayurveda Aahara foods, including formulation, claims, labelling and approval considerations. Product classification is fact-specific and therapeutic claims can shift the regulatory pathway.

title: Drugs and Cosmetics Act, 1940 and Rules, 1945
summary: Core Indian framework for drugs and cosmetics, including Ayurveda, Siddha and Unani medicines through the Act and Rules. Intended use, ingredients, dosage form and claims determine the applicable pathway.

title: WIPO Treaty on Intellectual Property, Genetic Resources and Associated Traditional Knowledge
effective_date: Adopted 2024-05-24; entry into force pending treaty conditions
summary: Treaty adopted in 2024 addressing patent disclosure requirements relating to genetic resources and associated traditional knowledge. Domestic implementation and entry-into-force status must be checked per jurisdiction.

title: Nagoya Protocol on Access and Benefit-sharing
summary: International ABS framework for access to genetic resources and fair and equitable benefit-sharing. Compliance depends on provider-country measures, checkpoints and the facts of access and utilization.

title: Directive 2004/24/EC on Traditional Herbal Medicinal Products
summary: Provides a simplified registration route for qualifying traditional herbal medicinal products, subject to evidence of traditional use, safety, quality and permitted indications.

title: Botanical Drug Development: Guidance for Industry
summary: FDA guidance for development of botanical drugs, including quality controls, nonclinical and clinical considerations. It is guidance, not a substitute for binding law or product-specific FDA advice.

title: Agreement on Trade-Related Aspects of Intellectual Property Rights
summary: International baseline for IP protection and enforcement among WTO members. National patent, trademark, design and geographical-indication laws implement and may exceed these minimum standards.

title: EPO Open Patent Services
summary: Official EPO web service for bibliographic, family, legal-event and published-document data. IP-SAKTI uses credentialed OPS results for family-aware and claim-level screening.

title: European Patent Convention — Article 52
summary: Sets the EPC baseline that European patents are granted for inventions that are new, involve an inventive step and are susceptible of industrial application, subject to exclusions.

title: 35 U.S.C. § 102 — Conditions for patentability; novelty
authority: United States Patent and Trademark Office
summary: United States novelty provision used with the complete statute, MPEP guidance and current case law for product-specific analysis.

title: USPTO Open Data Portal API Catalog
authority: United States Patent and Trademark Office
summary: Official USPTO API catalog. Registered API access can supplement EPO family screening with United States patent data and prosecution records.

title: NCBI Entrez Programming Utilities
summary: Official NCBI API used to retrieve PubMed records and abstracts for transparent extraction of population, dose, endpoints and stated limitations.

title: Manual of Patent Office Practice and Procedure
authority: Office of the Controller General of Patents, Designs and Trade Marks
summary: Indian Patent Office practice manual used as procedural guidance alongside the Patents Act, Rules, current office notices and case law.
